load_config_from_hub: load a diffusers model or scheduler config dictionary from the Hugging Face Hub using ConfigMixin.load_config
save_config_to_directory: save a diffusers config object to a local directory as a JSON file using ConfigMixin.save_config
instantiate_from_config: instantiate a diffusers model or scheduler from a config dict using ConfigMixin.from_config
register_init_to_config: decorate an __init__ method with register_to_config so all init arguments are auto-registered in the config
serialize_config_to_json: serialize a diffusers config object to a JSON string using ConfigMixin.to_json_string
